demand_description: The drill as designed: a single line on the floor; step-and-slide in all four directions; 4 × 2 min, rung 1.
coach_watch_point: Bouncing off both feet; standing upright.

demand_description: The coach calls the direction at random, and the athlete changes without resetting.
coach_watch_point: Does the stance survive the sudden change.

demand_description: One round of the plan only, coach-guided.
coach_watch_point: Can the athlete hold the plan for one round in real time?

demand_description: The drill as designed: the gameplan against a specific opponent, round by round, 10 min daily in week B.
coach_watch_point: Is every round of the plan rehearsed?

demand_description: The full plan in real time from both perspectives, set in the actual venue or with its photos.
coach_watch_point: Does the venue detail change how the plan feels?

demand_description: One boxer attacks the body and the other only defends, switching on the coach's call.
coach_watch_point: Does the attacker change level with the legs.

demand_description: The drill as designed: no head shots at all; body only; 6 × 2 min.
coach_watch_point: Head shots creeping in.

demand_description: Both boxers vary their entries (angles, level changes, feints) and the defending boxer must deny or exit each one.
coach_watch_point: Do head shots creep in as the pace rises.

demand_description: Walk the line slowly and slip only on the coach's call, checking stance after each slip.
coach_watch_point: Do the knees bend before the head moves.

demand_description: The drill as designed: slipping while moving along the rope at head height; 4 × 2 min.
coach_watch_point: Any fold at the waist.

demand_description: Move faster and change direction along the rope on the coach's call, still slipping with the legs.
coach_watch_point: Does the waist fold when the pace rises.

demand_description: The partner jabs slowly on a count; the boxer pulls and returns one jab.
coach_watch_point: Is the pull small and the return on time.

demand_description: The drill as designed: partner jabs; pull back, then land as they fall short; 4 × 2 min.
coach_watch_point: Pulling straight back without the return.

demand_description: The partner varies the timing and length of the jab; the boxer still pulls only as far as needed and returns.
coach_watch_point: Does the boxer over-pull when the jab changes.

demand_description: The partner pressures with steps only, without punching, and the athlete practises pivot and angle exits against the advance.
coach_watch_point: Does the athlete pivot off before being backed up.

demand_description: The drill as designed: a straight-back retreat loses the point; the athlete must pivot or angle out, and the round continues with the rule enforced.
coach_watch_point: Any straight step back, and is the point taken.

demand_description: Rounds start with one athlete near the ropes or a corner, where backing straight out is most tempting; the same rule holds.
coach_watch_point: Does the athlete use an exit plan at the edge or back into it.

demand_description: Bodyweight or a lower rear-foot support, same pause at the bottom.
coach_watch_point: Is the pause held with no bounce?

demand_description: The drill as designed: 3 × 6–8/side @ RPE 7–8.
coach_watch_point: Does every rep pause at the bottom?

demand_description: The top of the effort range (RPE 8), as in the Long Road's Phase 2 strength session, same pause and position.
coach_watch_point: Does the front shin stay near vertical at the higher effort?

demand_description: The coach names the destination quadrant before each exchange.
coach_watch_point: Does the boxer get there by angle, with stance intact.

demand_description: The drill as designed: live round; every exchange finishes in a different quadrant.
coach_watch_point: Exchanges that end where they began.

demand_description: The partner is told to cut off the boxer's nearest new quadrant; the boxer must still reach a different one.
coach_watch_point: Does the boxer find another lane, or run into the cut.

demand_description: One scenario, coach-guided, ending with the refocusing routine.
coach_watch_point: Does the imagery reach the response?

demand_description: The drill as designed: coping imagery (being hurt, being behind, a bad decision, the opponent doing the thing you fear, and responding well), 10 min daily in week C.
coach_watch_point: Is the response imaged as fully as the adversity?

demand_description: Two adversities in the same imagined round (for example being hurt early, then being behind), in real time, with the boxing back imaged in full.
coach_watch_point: Does the second adversity get its own response?

demand_description: The partner watches for one tell only (the shoulder dip), and the jab is slower.
coach_watch_point: Is that tell gone.

demand_description: The drill as designed: partner watches, calls “seen”; 3 × 20 jabs, scored.
coach_watch_point: Is the partner calling honestly.

demand_description: The partner watches for all three tells and the boxer varies the timing between jabs.
coach_watch_point: Does a new tell appear when the timing changes.

demand_description: Commands come at a steady rhythm with a pause between them, using two commands only ("Jab" and "Move").
coach_watch_point: Is the action right before it is fast?

demand_description: The drill as designed: move around the floor and react immediately to "Jab", "One-two" or "Move" (2 minutes work).
coach_watch_point: Late or wrong actions.

demand_description: Commands come at an irregular rhythm and sometimes back to back, so the athlete cannot predict the next call.
coach_watch_point: Does the athlete start guessing the next command?

demand_description: Single rear-hand punches with a freeze after each to check the finish.
coach_watch_point: Is the sequence complete before the freeze.

demand_description: The drill as designed: bag; perfect sequencing at 50% output; 4 × 2 min.
coach_watch_point: Is it turning into a rest round.

demand_description: The coach calls the punch or a short combination at random; output stays at half and the sequence stays perfect.
coach_watch_point: Does the sequence hold on calls the athlete did not choose.

demand_description: The partner pressures at a slower pace in a wider channel; same rule, same controlled contact as B.
coach_watch_point: Does the first move go sideways, not back.

demand_description: The drill as designed: taped channel; back line loses the round; 5 × 2 min, rung 6.
coach_watch_point: Any straight step back toward the line.

demand_description: A narrower channel, so the lateral exits are tighter.
coach_watch_point: Do the exits stay lateral in less space.

demand_description: Step-jab forward only along a floor line.
coach_watch_point: Do hand and foot land together.

demand_description: The drill as designed: open floor, lines; jab while stepping in, out, and both laterals; 4 × 2 min.
coach_watch_point: Punch then step, or step then punch.

demand_description: The coach calls the direction just before each jab.
coach_watch_point: Do hand and foot still land together on a called direction.

demand_description: Partner throws the straight punch pre-called at a slow, fixed rhythm; athlete makes the slip, holds shape for a beat, then returns 2 – 3 and pivots out.
constraint_applied: Pre-called feed; pause after the slip.
coach_watch_point: Is the slip finishing in a position the athlete can punch from.

demand_description: The drill as designed: partner throws the straight punch at low speed in fixed roles; athlete makes the slip, returns 2 – 3 and pivots out.
coach_watch_point: Does the return start from the slip, without a reset first.

demand_description: Partner varies the tempo of the straight punch and sometimes covers up after it; athlete returns 2 – 3 when the line is open and pivots out without punching when it is closed.
constraint_applied: Random tempo; return only into an open line.
coach_watch_point: Does the athlete read the window or fire the 2 – 3 every time.

demand_description: Lighter resistance, same fast turn.
coach_watch_point: Is the turn still fast and led by the hips?

demand_description: The drill as designed: 3 × 8/side, fast.
coach_watch_point: Is every rep fast?

demand_description: Chops from boxing stance, or more resistance, while every rep stays fast with a controlled finish.
coach_watch_point: Does speed hold with the change?

demand_description: The leader uses steps only (forward, back, side to side) at a slow pace; pivots and level changes come in once the steps are clean.
coach_watch_point: Do the feet stay uncrossed on every step.

demand_description: The drill as designed: the leader moves with steps, pivots and level changes, the partner mirrors in real time, and roles switch every 60–90 seconds.
coach_watch_point: Is the mirror moving in real time.

demand_description: The mirror must also hold the same distance from the leader the whole time, not drifting closer or further, while the leader changes rhythm.
coach_watch_point: Is the mirror drifting closer or further.

demand_description: Reduced pressure with a floor marker: the feeder pressures more slowly and the athlete frames and pivots to the marker.
constraint_applied: Reduced pressure; floor marker for the pivot.
coach_watch_point: Does the athlete pivot to the marker without a straight-back step?

demand_description: The drill as designed: the feeder pressures slowly without chasing wild contact; the athlete frames, pivots, and jabs out or resets. 3-5 rounds.
coach_watch_point: How many straight-back steps come before the angle?

demand_description: Pressure cue with light touch: the feeder adds light touches to the pressure, and the athlete still frames and pivots out.
coach_watch_point: Does the touch make the athlete back straight up or panic?

demand_description: One boxer leads and the other only reads and defends, at 25%, switching on the coach's call.
coach_watch_point: Does the reader move on the start of the action.

demand_description: The drill as designed: both boxers at 25% speed, full technical freedom; 5 × 3 min.
coach_watch_point: Any speed creep.

demand_description: Same 25% speed, but both boxers add feints; each answers only real actions.
constraint_applied: Feints added; answer real actions only.
coach_watch_point: Does the boxer bite on feints.

demand_description: Fewer variations with a lighter band, same control.
coach_watch_point: Are the shoulders staying down on every rep?

demand_description: The drill as designed: face pulls, external rotation at multiple angles, prone Y/T/W and serratus work, 3×/week.
coach_watch_point: Is every exercise done with control, not momentum?

demand_description: More external-rotation angles or slightly firmer resistance, same control.
coach_watch_point: Does control hold at the new angle or resistance?

demand_description: Single hook only: one slow hook, freeze the finish, then pivot or step out.
coach_watch_point: Is the finish frozen in guard before the exit?

demand_description: The drill as designed: at hook range on bag or mitt, hook, recover the guard, then pivot or step out; the feeder forces a defensive responsibility after the hook. 4 x 3 minutes.
coach_watch_point: Is the rear hand still home when the feeder's defensive responsibility comes?

demand_description: Check hook against a pressure cue: the feeder steps in and the athlete answers with a hook that turns them off the line.
coach_watch_point: Does the athlete leave the line with the hook, or stay in front of the pressure?

demand_description: Partner A moves very slowly and to one side at a time, so B can match each slip cleanly.
constraint_applied: Very slow lead; one side at a time.
coach_watch_point: Is the slip coming from the knees?

demand_description: The drill as designed: Partner A leads slow left/right movement; Partner B mirrors with small slips only; switch leader at 2 minutes.
coach_watch_point: Slips growing bigger than the leader's movement.

demand_description: Partner A changes rhythm and direction without warning (still slow, still left and right), so B must read and match each change.
coach_watch_point: Do the slips stay small when the lead changes?

demand_description: The objective is one simple behaviour the athlete has already shown in cued rounds, so the athlete only has to hold it without reminders.
coach_watch_point: Is the athlete still working on the objective without reminders.

demand_description: The drill as designed: the round starts with a stated objective, the coach stays silent throughout, and the debrief follows the round.
coach_watch_point: Does the athlete self-correct after a mistake.

demand_description: Before the bell the athlete also states a short plan of their own for the objective; at the debrief they compare the plan with what happened.
constraint_applied: Athlete's own plan, compared at the debrief.
coach_watch_point: Can the athlete say how the round differed from the plan.

demand_description: The partner attacks with single straight punches at a slower pace; the boxer solves each with a step or an angle.
coach_watch_point: Does the boxer move before the punch arrives.

demand_description: The drill as designed: the boxer may not punch; feet and distance first; 4 × 2 min.
coach_watch_point: Turtling behind the guard.

demand_description: The partner pressures in a bounded space and works to cut the boxer off; the boxer still defends with the feet first.
coach_watch_point: Does the boxer back straight to the boundary or turtle.

demand_description: Two punches and leave: the cap drops to two, or the coach pre-calls the combination, until the athlete controls the finish.
coach_watch_point: Is the last punch seen and owned before the exit.

demand_description: The drill as designed: no more than three punches per exchange, reset after each exchange, round kept under control.
coach_watch_point: Does anyone throw a fourth punch.

demand_description: The cap stays at three, but the athlete changes the sequence from exchange to exchange.
coach_watch_point: Does the third punch stay controlled when the sequence changes.

demand_description: Dumbbells or a lighter bar, same full lockout and braced trunk.
coach_watch_point: Does the trunk stay braced at lockout?

demand_description: The drill as designed: standing overhead press, dose from the session plan.
coach_watch_point: Is lockout reached without the back arching?

demand_description: More load, only while lockout stays clean and the boxing check holds.
constraint_applied: Load rises only with clean transfer.
coach_watch_point: Does the bar path stay straight at the new load?

demand_description: The partner jabs slowly on a count; the boxer catches, returns one jab and holds stance for a moment to check it.
coach_watch_point: Does the glove deflect or absorb.

demand_description: The drill as designed: partner jabs; catch with the rear glove, immediate jab back; 4 × 2 min.
coach_watch_point: Palm-forward catches.

demand_description: The partner varies jab timing and sometimes doubles it; the boxer catches each and returns the jab after the last one.
coach_watch_point: Does the boxer return between the two jabs.

demand_description: Cap the score at one punch, then exit; the coach may call the exits.
coach_watch_point: Does the exit start right after the punch?

demand_description: The drill as designed: 3 rounds at 45 sec / 15 sec; one to two punches max; exit after every score; no chase.
coach_watch_point: Staying, chasing, panic combos, scoring without leaving.

demand_description: Change the allowed sequence from round to round (for example jab only, then jab-cross), keeping the cap of two and the exit after every score.
constraint_applied: Allowed sequence changes each round; cap stays.
coach_watch_point: Does the cap still hold when the sequence changes?

demand_description: The partner moves in a steady, predictable pattern; the boxer steers them to the taped area.
coach_watch_point: Is the boxer cutting or following.

demand_description: The drill as designed: the boxer scores by getting the partner to a specific taped area.
coach_watch_point: Does the boxer take lanes away, or chase.

demand_description: The partner changes direction and speed unpredictably; the boxer must still steer them to the area.
coach_watch_point: Does the boxer stay calm as the partner changes.

demand_description: Layer 1, Isolation: a strict pause on every rep; the coach calls the freeze, asks what the athlete sees, then lets them decide and move, and freezes again at the reset.
coach_watch_point: Can the athlete freeze anytime, in balance?

demand_description: Layer 2, Controlled Flow: pauses slightly shorter, the same thinking process, transitions beginning to flow.
coach_watch_point: Ask what they just decided; no answer means they are rushing.

demand_description: Layer 3, Reactive Flow: minimal visible pause and full-speed thinking; the same rules still hold.
coach_watch_point: Is the athlete still deciding, just faster?

demand_description: The coach sets the position first, and the athlete holds it with the focus on control and position, for a shorter hold than B.
coach_watch_point: Does the front knee stay over the toes with the heel down?

demand_description: The drill as designed: the split-squat iso hold as DOC-089 directs, pushing through the front foot and squeezing the glute.
coach_watch_point: Is the athlete holding the position, not rising out of it?

demand_description: The same position held at max tension, driving hard through the front foot for the whole hold.
coach_watch_point: Does the knee still track over the toes at max tension?

demand_description: The partner moves at a slower pace with single shots only, so range is easier to read; the scoring stays.
coach_watch_point: Are the misses coming from reaching or from guessing.

demand_description: The drill as designed: live round; only clean landed shots count and each miss deducts a point.
coach_watch_point: Count the misses and where they come from.

demand_description: The partner changes range often, stepping in and out, so the boxer must find range again before every shot.
coach_watch_point: Does the boxer re-find range before throwing.

demand_description: Three rounds: technical scoring, movement, sustained pace.
coach_watch_point: Does each round look different, matching its job?

demand_description: Four rounds, adding defense discipline as Round 4.
coach_watch_point: Does the defense round keep the guard and stance of Round 1?

demand_description: Five rounds, adding fatigue management as Round 5 (the coach manual marks it advanced).
coach_watch_point: Is the guard still coming back after every punch in Round 5?

demand_description: One athlete jabs and the other defends only (guard, feet, slips), switching on the coach's call; light, controlled contact as in B.
coach_watch_point: Does the jab still step and recoil when no jab is coming back.

demand_description: The drill as designed: both athletes jab only, no rear-hand punches, light controlled contact, round 60–120 seconds.
coach_watch_point: Rear hand at the chin on every jab.

demand_description: Both athletes may double the jab and add jabs to the body; the rear hand stays defensive only.
constraint_applied: Lead hand only; rear hand defensive.
coach_watch_point: Is the rear hand sneaking in.

demand_description: 4 repetitions with the full recovery, on an air bike or Watt bike, same all-out intent.
coach_watch_point: Is every rep still all-out from the first second?

demand_description: The drill as designed: 30 seconds maximal effort, 3–4 minutes recovery, 4–6 repetitions.
coach_watch_point: Is there any pacing in the first seconds?

demand_description: Progress in the Long Road's order: 4 → 6 reps over 4–6 weeks, then recovery cut to 2.5–3 min, then output at fixed volume.
constraint_applied: One progression step at a time.
coach_watch_point: Does peak output hold after the change?

demand_description: One allowed punch: the athlete scores with a single punch, then exits and resets.
coach_watch_point: Does the exit start the moment the punch lands?

demand_description: The drill as designed: the athlete scores once or twice, then exits and resets; the partner punishes the athlete for staying stuck. Rounds are set per athlete.
coach_watch_point: Does the athlete stay in the exchange after scoring?

demand_description: Opponent pressure after the exit: the partner follows the exit, and the athlete must still reset or score again from structure.
coach_watch_point: Does the follow-up pressure drag the athlete back into staying?

demand_description: The pulls only (clean pull, high pull, snatch pull): no catch, for a fraction of the learning cost.
coach_watch_point: Is the extension fast and full before the arms bend?

demand_description: The drill as designed: 4–5 × 3 @ 70–85%.
coach_watch_point: Does the bar stay close on every rep?

demand_description: The hang clean, with the catch, once the pulls are sound.
coach_watch_point: Is the catch on the shoulders balanced, with the bar close?

demand_description: Measure and mark jab range only, and drill from that one mark.
coach_watch_point: Does the jab land at full extension without a lean.

demand_description: The drill as designed: tape at jab, cross and hook range; 15 min, once, then revisit.

demand_description: The athlete moves freely, the coach calls a range, and the athlete stops on it without looking down, then checks the tape.
coach_watch_point: How far off the tape the athlete stops.

demand_description: The coach calls the last 20 seconds and gives one closing plan before the round; the partner works at a slower pace.

demand_description: The drill as designed: the last 20 seconds of each round score double, with the coach calling the window.

coach_watch_point: Does the head cross wait for the opening.

coach_watch_point: Does the athlete pivot before the corner, not at it?

demand_description: Athletes choose the combination and exit themselves from the drill's examples (jab hook angle step, double jab step out, jab to body then pivot outside), reading the partner.

coach_watch_point: Does the body jab come back to stance before the cross.

demand_description: The drill as designed: 1 (body) – 2 (head) on the bag or pads with a predictable feed, from mid range, finishing with a lateral step.

demand_description: One planned change for the third ending, the same every time.

demand_description: More load, or the rotation from boxing stance, while the arc stays controlled.

demand_description: Slips only, left and right, slowly, on the coach's cue, for technical precision.

coach_watch_point: Does the boxer adjust urgency without chasing.

demand_description: Role-bound rounds after the finisher: one boxer works and the other defends, switching on the coach's call.
coach_watch_point: Does structure hold in the simpler picture.

demand_description: The drill as designed: sparring immediately after a conditioning finisher; used sparingly.
coach_watch_point: Composure and technique under fatigue.

demand_description: Same sparring with a visible scoreboard and clock.
coach_watch_point: Does composure hold when the score is on show.

demand_description: Slow quarter-pivots with a freeze and balance check after each.
coach_watch_point: Is the athlete balanced at the freeze.

demand_description: The drill as designed: one cone; pivot 90° off the lead foot, reset, repeat; then rear-foot pivots; 3 × 90 s each.
coach_watch_point: Any flat-foot pivot or loss of balance.

demand_description: Pivot on the coach's call, on the lead or rear foot as called.
coach_watch_point: Is balance still there on an unexpected call.

demand_description: The partner moves at a steady pace in one line only (forward and back).
coach_watch_point: Does the boxer match every step?

demand_description: The drill as designed: the boxer must remain within 5 cm of the boundary of their own range for the entire round.
coach_watch_point: How much of the round is spent on the edge?

demand_description: The partner changes pace and angle freely and tries to close or open the distance.
constraint_applied: Partner free to change pace and angle.
coach_watch_point: Does the edge hold when the partner changes angle?

demand_description: Lighter weight or band, same straight path and pause.
coach_watch_point: Is the path straight and the pause held?

demand_description: The drill as designed: upper trap shrugs and scapular retraction, integrated with shoulder work.
coach_watch_point: Is the movement controlled, not jerked?

demand_description: Heavier shrugs or a firmer band, same control and pause.
coach_watch_point: Does the pause still hold at the higher resistance?

demand_description: The partner closes slowly on a steady rhythm; the boxer frames and steps off on the coach's call.
constraint_applied: Slow closes; step off on call.
coach_watch_point: Is the step-off at an angle every time?

demand_description: The drill as designed: the partner closes; the boxer uses the forearm frame and steps off at an angle; 3 × 2 min.
coach_watch_point: Does the frame lead straight into the step-off?

demand_description: The partner closes at varying speeds and angles, and the boxer chooses which side to step off to.
constraint_applied: Varied closes; boxer picks the side.
coach_watch_point: Does the boxer pick the open side?

demand_description: The coach calls the check once per round (for example “stay loose”) and the boxer runs it.
coach_watch_point: Do the shoulders drop on the call?

demand_description: The drill as designed: every round, once, the boxer checks the jaw and the shoulders.
coach_watch_point: Does the boxer do it without a prompt?

demand_description: The boxer runs the check without prompts in harder rounds (late in the session, or sparring the athlete already does), and the coach checks afterwards whether it happened.
coach_watch_point: Did the check happen in every round?

demand_description: Side plank from the knees, or the short end of the hold range, same straight line.
coach_watch_point: Is the line straight from head to knees?

demand_description: The drill as designed: 2 × 30–45 s/side.
coach_watch_point: Do the hips stay up for the whole hold?

demand_description: A harder variant, such as the top leg raised or a reach-through, same straight line.
coach_watch_point: Does the line hold in the harder variant?

demand_description: Shadow, slow and pre-called: 6, freeze to check the path and the protecting hand, then 3 and the turn out.
constraint_applied: Shadow only; freeze after the uppercut.
coach_watch_point: Does the uppercut come back through the guard.

demand_description: The drill as designed: 6 – 3 on the bag or pads with a predictable feed, at close range, finishing with a turn out.
coach_watch_point: Is the hook short, onto the lifted target.

demand_description: Pads with an unpredictable feed: the holder changes the distance between reps, and the athlete throws 6 – 3 only at close range, holding and resetting when it is not.
constraint_applied: Holder varies the range; no close range, no uppercut.
coach_watch_point: Does the athlete reach for the uppercut from too far out.

demand_description: Planned reset: the athlete resets after every combination, on a known rhythm, freezing to check feet, hands and eyes.
coach_watch_point: Are feet, hands and eyes all back before the next combination?

demand_description: The drill as designed: shadowboxing or on the bag, the coach calls reset unpredictably after punches, misses, exits or fatigue moments; the athlete stops and regains stance, guard, vision, breath and angle. 3-minute rounds.
coach_watch_point: Does the athlete restart before balanced?

demand_description: Random reset after a defensive cue: the coach calls the reset at random right after a defensive action, so the athlete must defend and then reset without delay.
coach_watch_point: Is the reset still immediate and balanced after the defensive action?

demand_description: A lighter ball and a slower toss, same quick stop.
coach_watch_point: Is the stop quick and in balance?

demand_description: The drill as designed: catch and stop a rotational throw, 3 × 6/side.
coach_watch_point: Does the rotation stop short every rep?

demand_description: A faster or less predictable toss, same quick stop and stance.
coach_watch_point: Does the stop stay quick when the toss is faster?

demand_description: Dim light only, with the partner at a slower pace and single shots.
coach_watch_point: Is the boxer using the jab to find range.

demand_description: The drill as designed: live round with partial vision (one eye covered, or dim light).
coach_watch_point: Leaning in to see, or holding distance by feel.

demand_description: One eye covered, and the partner changes range and rhythm often.
coach_watch_point: Does the boxer still reset instead of guessing.

demand_description: Lighter load or a shorter range, same knee tracking.
coach_watch_point: Do the knees track over the feet?

demand_description: The drill as designed: belt, hack or safety-bar squat, dose from the session plan.
coach_watch_point: Is depth the same on every rep?

demand_description: More load, only while depth, knee tracking and the boxing check hold.
constraint_applied: Load rises only with clean transfer.
coach_watch_point: Is the boxing check after the lift still clean at the new load?

demand_description: The partner tries to throw only single punches on a steady rhythm.
coach_watch_point: Does the jab arrive before the partner's punch starts.

demand_description: The drill as designed: partner tries to throw; boxer's jab must obscure vision; 3 × 2 min, rung 5.
coach_watch_point: Any jab thrown to hurt.

demand_description: The partner throws freely and moves; the boxer keeps blinding while moving with them.
coach_watch_point: Does the jab stay light when the picture gets busier.

demand_description: Hunt one tell only, named before the round.
coach_watch_point: Does the boxer answer that tell when it shows.

demand_description: The drill as designed: film a partner, identify their tells, spar hunting those tells; one session per partner.
coach_watch_point: Guessing at tells that are not there.

demand_description: The partner is told in private to hide or change a tell part-way through; the boxer must notice and adjust.
coach_watch_point: Does the boxer notice the change or keep hunting the old tell.

demand_description: Shadow crosses from a freeze, no bag.
coach_watch_point: Does the heel turn before the hip.

demand_description: The drill as designed: bag, slow tempo; 3 × 15 slow crosses.
coach_watch_point: Arming; a flat rear heel.

demand_description: The coach calls go or no-go; the athlete throws the slow cross only on go, foot first every time.
coach_watch_point: Does the foot still start the punch when the throw is called.

demand_description: The partner shows one real look and one fake look, clearly different, at a slow pace.
coach_watch_point: Does the athlete hold on the fake?

demand_description: The drill as designed: 30 sec rounds × 5; the partner alternates real and fake looks quickly; throw only on real openings.
coach_watch_point: Guessing, panic punches, reacting to every movement.

demand_description: The partner mixes feints in and changes the order of real and fake looks, so the athlete must read each one live.
coach_watch_point: Does the athlete jump on feints?

demand_description: The deficit is announced between rounds, with one cue for how to win the next round.
coach_watch_point: Does the next round start with more urgency?

demand_description: The drill as designed: score deficits announced mid-round, requiring a change in urgency.
coach_watch_point: How quickly does urgency change?

demand_description: A second announcement later in the round changes the deficit (bigger or smaller), and the boxer has to adjust urgency again.
coach_watch_point: Does the boxer adjust a second time?
